purpose: Work with Google apps through scoped OAuth and verified API receipts.

trigger: Search my Gmail for the project discussion
Add the meeting to my connected calendar
Create a Google document from this approved brief
do_not_trigger: Read a local Python repository without Google services
Create an Obsidian note on disk

preflight: Use the existing authenticated connector and least-privilege scopes; never print OAuth tokens.
Resolve exact account, document/calendar/message target and permission level.
Distinguish read from write, send and sharing operations before acting.
workflow: Read the target and assemble an explicit change preview.
Obtain exact owner authorization for writes or messages.
Use API idempotency where available and reconcile unknown responses.
Verify created or changed Google resource ID with a read-back.

evidence.how_to_verify: Read exact resource ID and revision before any write.
Read resource back and compare intended change with actual state.

failure_modes: On expired OAuth, request reconnect without extracting credential contents.
On uncertain API response, read back before retrying writes.
